name: docker
description: Docker image build for SMM (CLI + UI + bin)

scripts.build:run: pnpm run build && docker run --rm -p 30000:30000 smm:latest
scripts.build:ffmpeg: docker buildx build --progress=plain $(bash ../../ci/docker-3pp-build-args.sh ffmpeg) -t smm-ffmpeg:latest -f ffmpeg.Dockerfile ../..
scripts.build:ytdlp: docker buildx build --progress=plain $(bash ../../ci/docker-3pp-build-args.sh ytdlp) -t smm-ytdlp:latest -f ytdlp.Dockerfile ../..
scripts.build:bgutil: docker buildx build --progress=plain $(bash ../../ci/docker-3pp-build-args.sh bgutil) -t smm-bgutil:latest -f bgutil.Dockerfile ../..
scripts.build:videocaptioner: docker buildx build --progress=plain $(bash ../../ci/docker-3pp-build-args.sh videocaptioner) -t smm-videocaptioner:latest -f videocaptioner.Dockerfile ../..
